title: Pages CMS — block-composed multi-page editor
description: A small multi-page CMS: list, create, edit, duplicate, and publish pages composed from 11 block kinds (hero, text, feature-list, cta, logo-cloud, testimonial, video, image-gallery, faq, stats, pricing-table). Admin views (PagesView list + CRUD, PageEditorView block editor) plus a read-only public BlockRenderer. Ships a localStorage adapter (LocalPagesProvider) + a generic Home/About/Pricing seed so it runs env-free — or wire the bundled reducer/store-context to your own backend. Pure UI; no Convex required.
